title: The Crate at the Relay
summary: A crate bound east has waited at the relay since the bridge went out.

evidence.title: The manifest
evidence.text: Lists the crate as orchard pump fittings, relay seal applied.

evidence.title: What's inside
evidence.text: Heavy, finely threaded brass fittings packed in straw. Not pump parts like Tobin's.

evidence.title: The seal
evidence.text: The crate's wax seal has a ring of notches; the relay's own stamp is a plain wheel.

evidence.title: Tobin's order
evidence.text: Tobin's pin and valve leather were sent east with the relay carter and never came back.

evidence.title: The pump
evidence.text: Plain iron pin, leather valve. Ordinary wear.

hypotheses.text: A clerical mistake: wrong label, wrong seal
hypotheses.reaction: Mistakes happen. Two at once is less common.

hypotheses.text: Something is being shipped under a false label
hypotheses.reaction: A guess. But the label, the contents and the seal all disagree.

hypotheses.text: Jory is careless with his paperwork
hypotheses.reaction: Jory would be mortified to hear it.
